programme.title: Kulmakivi
programme.desc: Martti Muurikainen. Ihmeiden äärellä, osa 2. Martti toteaa, että kun on parantamisen armolahjan saanut, sitä tulee nöyrästi käyttää. Tässä omat luulot otetaan kokonaan pois. Joskus avunpyytäjän kohdalla rukoilijan oma uskokin alkoi horjua.

programme.title: Haastattelussa
programme.desc: Jason Lepojärvi, osa 1/2. Brittikirjailija ja ajattelija C. S. Lewisin ajaton viisaus puhuttelee sukupolvia toisensa jälkeen. Yhdysvaltalaisessa George Fox -yliopistossa työskentelevä teologian tohtori ja C. S. Lewis -professori Jason Lepojärvi kertoo toimittaja Toni Randénille, miten Lewisin ajattelu tarjoaa syvällisiä työkaluja elämän suurten kysymysten – kuten rakkauden, ystävyyden, kärsimyksen ja hengellisen kaipauksen – ymmärtämiseen.

programme.desc: Kun koettelemukset iskevät, osa 1/2. Me kaikki koemme vaikeuksia ja haasteita elämässä. Kuinka voimme menestyksekkäästi käsitellä niitä ja selviytyä niiden keskellä?

programme.title: Kujalla
programme.desc: Jakamaton ihmisarvo perustuu luomiseen. Aleksi Markkanen. Viime viikkoina julkisuudessa on käyty keskustelua ihmisarvosta. Mikä määrittää ihmisen arvon? Jos ihmisen arvo ei perustu hänen tuottavuuteensa tai hyödyllisyyteensä vaan ihminen itsessään on arvokas - miten se perustellaan? Mitä eroa on ihmisarvolla ja ihmisoikeuksilla? Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: When Racers discover that for the first time in THE AMAZING RACE history there is a double elimination, they are forced to step up their game. However, costly mistakes jeopardize multiple teams' chances at staying in the Race.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: Don't Lay Down On Me Now
programme.desc: One Team is stranded in Indonesia as they watch their competition race by, and two Teams join forces to push through a mind-numbing mental challenge.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: This Is Gonna Be A Fine Mess
programme.desc: Teams struggle with an underwater challenge which threatens their positions in the game, and one team’s love for the outdoors comes in handy during a tough climbing challenge.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: I Feel Like I'm In the Circus
programme.desc: Fearing they have broken the rules, one team takes a risk that could cost them the Race. Meanwhile, an unwanted speed bump turns into a dream excursion for Liz and Marie, but will it push them even farther back.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: We Love Your Country Already; It Is Very Spacious
programme.desc: After falling to the back of the pack, a disheartened racer is encouraged by the spirit of the local workers, and it’s an intense foot race to the first-ever Pit Stop in Malawi.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race through Malawi where a puzzling patriotic Roadblock causes one team to fall behind. Also, with a Double U-Turn on the line, teams must choose whether to sabotage their fellow Racers for a chance at first place.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Race travels to Copenhagen for the first time, where one Racer learns the meaning of two left feet and a double U-turn jeopardizes team positions in the Race.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: After a potentially game-changing error, one team hopes for a lucky break, and donning only a Speedo for their Detour task, Racers get in touch with their inner exhibitionists.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Racers put the pedal to the metal and shift into high gear when they take a thrilling test drive, and results are far from sweet when teams also try to recreate classic Belgian waffles.

programme.title: The Amazing Race

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்

programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.

நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

मस्करी
மஸ்கரி

programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்

programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le labyrinthe de la peur

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'ennemi de mon ennemi
programme.desc: Après avoir vu les Krangs à l'œuvre, Karai propose une alliance aux tortues. Mais est-elle digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La mission de Karaï
programme.desc: Le clan des Foot tente de capturer April, qui doit combattre Karaï si elle veut leur échapper.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'œuf
programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une évasion à haut risque
programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Les Krangs s'apprêtent à lancer la phase finale de l'invasion de la Terre. Ils préparent l'arrivée du Technodrome depuis la dimension X, qui se fera par le portail.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie
programme.desc: Leonardo a survécu à l'explosion du dernier étage du TCRI, mais n'a pu empêcher le passage du Technodrome par le portail. L'immense vaisseau en forme de sphère sème la terreur sur la ville, en tirant à vue et enlevant des humains...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: д/с Древние пришельцы (Путешественники во времени)
programme.desc: Возможно ли, что случаи встречи землян с НЛО на самом деле были свидетельствами посещения нашего времени путешественниками во времени из будущего? Ученые обсуждают теоретическую возможность путешествий во времени. Реж.: Кевин Барнс, Дэвид Сильвер. В ролях: Роберт Клотуорти, Гиоргио Цукалос, Дэвид Чайлдресс, Филип Коппенс, Эрих фон Дэникен, Джонатан Янг, Джейсон Мартелл, Джордж Нури, Майкл Деннин, Уильям Дж. Бирнс. США, 2009, фантастика, фэнтези, документалка, история

programme.title: д/с Невероятные проекты древнего мира (Самое грозное оружие)
programme.desc: В глубокой древности люди построили пушку, стрелявшую с помощью паровой энергии. Мы расскажем о древних боевых судах, которые были мощнее современных авианосцев, и о лучах смерти, сжигавших неприятельские корабли. Реж.: Стюарт Кларк, Bo Channon, Lawrance Channon. США

programme.title: д/с Хит-парад древности: Первая десятка (Великие достижения Рима)
programme.desc: Цивилизация Древнего Рима, определившая ход европейской истории, знала немало примеров передовых технологий. В этой серии мы расскажем о крупнейших прорывах в инженерном искусстве Древнего Рима. Реж.: Стюарт Кларк, Bo Channon. Вед.: Майкл Браун. США

programme.title: д/с Охотники за затонувшими сокровищами (Опасные подводные лодки)
programme.desc: Росс обучается подводному плаванию под руководством профессионального ныряльщика Нила Брока. Вдохновленный историями о сокровищах на затонувших кораблях, он отправляется на историческую военно-морскую базу в северной части Оркнейских островов. Реж.: Росс Кемп. Великобритания

programme.title: д/с Древние пришельцы (Заговор Да Винчи)
programme.desc: Можно ли предположить, что великий Леонардо да Винчи был знаком с инопланетной технологией и инопланетными существами на основе изучения его рисунков, глубоко проработанных технологически набросков, и частных дневников? Реж.: Кевин Барнс, Дэвид Сильвер. В ролях: Роберт Клотуорти, Гиоргио Цукалос, Дэвид Чайлдресс, Филип Коппенс, Эрих фон Дэникен, Джонатан Янг, Джейсон Мартелл, Джордж Нури, Майкл Деннин, Уильям Дж. Бирнс. США, 2009, фантастика, фэнтези, документалка, история

programme.title: д/с Древние открытия (Гигантские корабли)
programme.desc: От египетских парусников до боевых кораблей древних греков – речные и морские суда сыграли немаловажную роль в истории человечества. Реж.: Стюарт Кларк, Али МакГрат, Бен Моул. В ролях: Том Пэйн, Фил Краули, Шон Баррет, Кристофер Келли. США, Великобритания, Австралия, 2003-2008, документалка, история

programme.title: Охотники за потерянными реликвиями (Золото кельтов)
programme.desc: Карл и Гамильтон изучают выдающуюся коллекцию древних кельтских изделий из золота, найденного на Пиренейском полуострове. Среди экспонатов: золотая чаша стоимостью более миллиона долларов и каменный алтарь, посвященный богу Эндовеликусу

programme.title: д/с Исчезнувшие на Аляске (Жертвы косматого человека)

programme.title: Unvergessene Legenden - Summer of Love
programme.desc: Unvergessene Legenden - Heute: Summer of Love Der Ausdruck Summer of Love (Sommer der Liebe) bezeichnet eigentlich den Sommer des Jahres 1967, als die Hippiebewegung in Amerika auf ihrem Höhepunkt angelangt war. Aber auch der Sommer des Jahres 1969, in dem das Woodstock-Festival stattfand, wird als Summer of Live beszeichnet. Die Hits des "Summer of love" bis hin zum Woodstockfestival wurden zusammengestellt von Manfred Sexauer ausgewählt. Die Musik und die Geschichten einer verrückten Ära begleiten Sie durch durch diese Sendung.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping - Unabhängig von Ladenöffnungszeiten einkaufen, sich ausführlich über die unterschiedlichsten Produkte informieren, ohne sich von Verkaufspersonal bedrängt zu fühlen, und das Angebot durch ausführliche Präsentationen von allen Seiten richtig kennenlernen - das wird durch Teleshopping möglich. programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La légende d'Ours Rapide
programme.desc: Walker se porte au secours d'un jeune indien navajo, injustement accusé d'un meurtre par un agent du FBI...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Quelque chose dans l'ombre - 1ère partie
programme.desc: L'un des étudiants d'Alex a été enlevé sur le campus. Walker pense qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un cas isolé...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Quelque chose dans l'ombre - 2ème partie
programme.desc: Le doyen de l'université est suspecté par Walker d'être à l'origine d'une série de viols sur le campus...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Touche pas au gringo
programme.desc: Emilio Durazo, un chef de la mafia, a capturé Paco. Seuls Walker et Trivette peuvent le sauver...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Brève rencontre
programme.desc: Wayland Hampton, l'ancien amant de Merrilee, est prêt à tout pour la récupérer. Walker est chargé de la protection de la jeune femme...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Vive les vacances
programme.desc: Les vacances de Walker se transforment en une aventure imprévue : il est amené à aider un garçon poursuivi par un trafiquant de drogue...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les pirates de la route
programme.desc: Après une première et vaine tentative pour mettre un gang hors d'état de nuire, Walker et Trivette demandent à CD de les aider à préparer un nouveau coup...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Traquenards
programme.desc: Une station-service a été dévalisée puis incendiée par deux hommes. En se rendant sur les lieux, Walker et Trivette découvrent une jeune femme qui vient d'être agressée et violée...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Danger immédiat
programme.desc: Avec l'aide d'un ami, revenu au Texas afin de venger la mort de son fils unique, Walker et Trivette découvrent l'existence d'un complot à l'encontre du sénateur Julian Knox...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Le bébé volé
programme.desc: Walker met à jour un trafic d'enfants qui s'est organisé autour d'un candidat à la mairie. Celui-ci a adopté illégalement l'un de ces bambins...

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: L'insigne de la honte
programme.desc: Lorsqu’un shérif local met injustement un jeune homme noir derrière les barreaux, Walker et Trivette décident de prouver que le motif de l’arrestation était uniquement racial.

programme.desc: A dying man offers Josh $2000 to find his son, who ran away 15 years ago.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh and Jason are escorting prisoners to Leavenworth prison when a stranger begins following along behind.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is summoned for help when the Pinto bank is robbed.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh expects a bounty for bringing in Daniel Trenner but his prisoner is stolen by the sheriff. Ex-army personnel want to stage an illegal trial accusing their former lieutenant of dereliction of duty

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is hired by a woman to sober up Harry, a drunk who is also Josh's friend. She learned his wealthy brother who Harry hasn't seen in years is coming to visit so she wants Harry to be presentable.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh and the beautiful prisoner he is transporting are on a three day trip while her partner is still on the loose. For once Josh may not follow through on obeying the law as they fall in love.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is on his way to River City to transport three convicts there to be hanged. The dangerous prisoners escape and appoint themselves the law, after the town is hit by a tornado, killing the sheriff.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A journalist accompanies Josh on his manhunt to get an exclusive story on a bounty hunter. Josh agrees to let him join him in the hunt for Jack Torrance but finds they have different methods.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh feels compelled to repay a debt to an old friend who's in jail and may hang. However, the friend escapes, forcing Josh to go on the hunt for him until it appears he died when he went over a cliff

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh brings in outlaw Carlos Domingo, but he has to be released when the witness against him is killed. Josh concocts a surprise witness to testify against the notorious killer - his own mother.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is sent for by the desperate men of Coronado. He is hired to convince the women of the town to come back to their men when they leave demanding that all towns men give up their guns for good.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh brings in a man wanted for robbery but loses his reward. A well meaning doctor pays an innocent man to take the blame for his son, but the son sets out to kill the man to make sure he never tells

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh arrives in a town for rest just as the local bank has been robbed. A traveling medicine man knows the whereabouts of the suspect and wants Josh to help because he thinks the suspect is innocent.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A widow wants to hire/propose to Josh so she doesn't lose custody of her son. Josh served under her husband in the war. His mother now is trying to steal her grandson to take over the family fortune.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A woman asks Josh, an old friend, to help find her husband Frank - a bounty hunter out to settle a score. He wants to catch a young outlaw who shot him in the leg.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: In Mexico, Josh is hired to protect a man and his pregnant wife from his the villagers who are angered when he refuses the town healing woman or "witch" from being present when his wife gives birth.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: After Josh takes the task of finding a man and his wife's pet ewe, he becomes the butt of many jokes while cattlemen nearly hang him when he mentions sheep. His only clue is a gold bell the ewe wore.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: When a convicted killer escapes prison, Josh is hired to protect the woman whose testimony put him there. The woman's husband is a lawyer who says he has always been a coward and never carries a gun.

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations. Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

programme.title: Campsite
programme.desc: Der geheime Club - Episode 29: Nura und Silje folgen Thea heimlich zum Fundsachenraum, wo sie überraschend auf verschlossene Türen und geheimnisvolle Stimmen stoßen. Mit einem dramatisch inszenierten Notruf verschaffen sie sich Zugang - und platzen in die geheime Poetry-Slam-Probe von Thea, Lea und Theo. Nura fühlt sich ausgeschlossen.

programme.title: Campsite
programme.desc: Dirty Dancing - Episode 30: Sebbe plant eine große romantische Aktion auf der Campingplatz-Party, inspiriert von dem Film "Dirty Dancing", um Anja zu erobern. Aber Anja hat keine Lust auf Menschen und Tanzen und will nicht kommen. Mit einer Notlüge kann Sebbe sie doch noch zur Party locken - aber dann läuft alles schief.

programme.title: Campsite
programme.desc: Lost and Found - Episode 31: Theo, Thea, Nura und Silja kramen sich durch merkwürdige Sachen im Fundraum des Campingplatzes, als William kommt und ihnen von einer Begegnung mit der Südlandbande erzählt - einer Gruppe von zwei Jungs und einem Mädchen, die sich aufführen, als würden sie den ganzen Campingplatz besitzen. Theo lotst die Clique schnell an einen Ort, von wo sie aus einem Fenster beobachten können, wie die Bande den Eisstand überfällt.

programme.title: Max und die wilde 7
programme.desc: und andere Eine echte Ritterburg als neues Zuhause - kann man sich etwas Cooleres vorstellen? Ja, kann man, findet der neunjährige Max. Denn Burg Geroldseck ist ein Altersheim voller schrumpeliger Omas und Opas. Aber damit seine alleinerziehende Mutter, eine Altenpflegerin, auch Nachtschichten arbeiten kann, wohnt Max jetzt im Rabenturm. Als einziges Kind unter lauter alten Knackern. Doch seine Einstellung ändert sich, als ein Einbrecher auf der Burg auftaucht. Nun müssen Max und drei rüstige Rentner von Tisch 7, alias "die wilde 7", gemeinsame Sache machen und sich als Detektive beweisen ... An der Seite von Jona Eisenblätter bilden die Schauspiellegenden Uschi Glas, Günther Maria ...

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?
programme.desc: Wer weiß denn sowas? - Die beiden Rätselmeister Bernhard Hoëcker und Elton stellen sich erneut den unglaublichen, amüsanten und überraschenden Fragen von Moderator Kai Pflaume. Sie spielen im Team mit jeweils einem prominenten Studiogast, denn es gilt, richtige Antworten auf skurrile und knifflige Fragen aus Wissenschaft, Tierwelt und dem täglichen Leben zu finden. Beide Teams spielen um Bares für ihre Unterstützer. Zu Beginn des Wissensspiels müssen sich die Zuschauer im Studio entscheiden: Setzen sie sich auf die Seite von Superhirn Bernhard Hoëcker oder von Quizmaster Elton? Moderator Kai Pflaume sorgt für eine ausgeglichene Balance zwischen den Teamkapitänen, die zuweilen hoch emotional werden können. Es ...

programme.title: Im Ballon zum Balaton - Vom Burgenland zum Plattensee
programme.desc: Im Ballon zum Balaton - Vom Burgenland zum Plattensee - Die Österreicherin Elisabeth Kindermann ist Vizeweltmeistern im Ballonfahren. Sie startet eine ungewöhnliche Tour. Mit ihrem Ballon will sie vom österreichischen Neusiedlersee quer über die Puszta zum ungarischen Plattensee. Die Distanz beträgt nur rund 130 Kilometer. Doch die Aufgabe ist nicht einfach, schließlich herrscht hier meistens Ostwind, der den Ballon in die falsche Richtung treibt.

programme.title: Garten & Lecker
programme.desc: Parmigiana aus dem Exotengarten - Menü: Italienischer Vorspeisenteller mit sardischem Aufschnitt, eingelegten Paprika, Oliven und Caprese Auberginen-Auflauf Parmigiana Tiramisu / WDR Es wird wieder gebuddelt, geschmückt und gefeiert. Beim charmanten Gartenwettbewerb dreht sich in Staffel sieben alles um das Motto "Tief verwurzelt". Die fünfte Gartenreise führt nach Emsdetten im Münsterland. Hier genießt Jacky Uda Urlaubsflair unter Palmen und Bananen. Den 400 Quadratmeter großen Garten mitten in einem Wohnviertel hat sie mit ihrem Mann Andre vor zwei Jahren geplant und angelegt. Auch sechs griechische Landschildkröten fühlen sich hier wohl. Neben den Exoten gibt es einen Teich und jede Menge Obst und Gemüse in ...

programme.title: Papageien, Palmen & Co.
programme.desc: Wer ist der Boss im Gehege? - Jaguardame Negra hat Nachwuchs bekommen - und das völlig unerwartet! Ganz heimlich hat sie in einer Ecke des Innen-Geheges zwei kleine Babys zur Welt gebracht: das eine schwarz wie sie und das andere gefleckt wie Vater Yellow, der kurzerhand erstmal ausquartiert werden musste. Alle sind begeistert: Negra kümmert sich sehr liebevoll um ihre Jungen und genießt ihr Mutterglück in vollen Zügen! Wer ist der Boss bei den Gorilla-Männchen? Kurator Matthias und Tierärztin Kirstin wollen es wissen. Mit einer Wackelpudding-Torte wollen sie herausfinden, ob Noel oder doch Maayabu der Chef der Junggesellengruppe ist. Das erkennt man nämlich deutlich daran, wer als Erster den Platz am Buffet für sich ...

programme.title: Papageien, Palmen & Co.
programme.desc: Wohl behütet - Nicht nur bei Seelöwin Marta gab es Nachwuchs, auch ihre Artgenossin Mara hat ein Junges zur Welt gebracht. Kurator Matthias und Kollegin Claudia schauen auf der "Baby-Station" vorbei, um sich die Seelöwenkinder Pedrito und Paul anzuschauen. Tierärztin Kirstin Oberhäuser kümmert sich liebevoll um ihr Faultierpflegekind, das im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes noch immer sehr an ihr hängt Und Biologe Raphael Zamora macht Spiegel - Experimente im Südamerikagehege.

programme.desc: Seehund Sam lernt um - Polizeihauptmeister Henrik Sielafff und sein Hund Rufus sind in der Gepäckaufbewahrung am Hamburger Hauptbahnhof. Beim zweiten Anlauf funktioniert Rufus' Spürnase einwandfrei, er zeigt den Sprengstoff vorschriftsgemäß an, denn der kleine Terrier hat schon einiges dazugelernt. Gemeinsam mit Pferdecoach Isabelle sitzt Reiterin Britta das erste Mal wieder in dem Sattel ihres Wallachs Victor. Endlich! Das Bangen und Hoffen hat sich gelohnt. Nach dem ersten Ritt fällt die Anspannung von Pferd und Reiterin ab. Jetzt können beide entspannt in die Zukunft schauen. Im Marine Science Center Rostock kümmert sich Biologin Jenny Byl heute um das medizinische Training der Robbe Sam. Der Meeressäuger ...

programme.title: Nashorn, Zebra & Co.
programme.desc: Leoparden sind wählerisch - Schneeleopard Felix ist ganz schön wählerisch: Was hält er diesmal von seinem Frühstück? Mähnenrobbe Pepe hat Probleme, jetzt bekommt sie Augentropfen. Auch der Elefantennachwuchs muss untersucht werden, deshalb ist Tierparkdirektor Andreas Knieriem als Tierarzt im Einsatz.

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Tod dem König - Hubert und Girwidz sollen eine unangemeldete Versammlung auflösen, über die sich ein Nachbar beschwert hat. Vor Ort stellen die beiden Polizisten jedoch fest, dass eine Gruppe maskierter junger Leute das Haus belagert und seltsame Forderungen stellt. Dann bricht auch noch ein Feuer auf dem Grundstück aus. Wenig später wird klar, Eigentümer Peter Weber ist in den Flammen umgekommen! Hubert und Girwidz erfahren von Kollegin Christina Bayer, dass es sich bei dem Opfer um einen Internet-Star handelt, der als Märchenkönig Ludwig II. verkleidet, täglich live im Internet gekocht und mit seinem Programm stark polarisiert hat. Ist Weber dem Hass seiner Gegner zum Opfer gefallen?

programme.title: Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Marderschaden - Hubert und Girwidz entdecken auf einer Wiese einen Motorradfahrer, der einen schweren Unfall hatte. Als sie anhalten wollen, versagen die Bremsen und der Streifenwagen landet ebenfalls im Gras. Die Polizisten kommen mit dem Schrecken davon, für Motorradfahrer Martin Fritz sieht es weniger gut aus - schwer verletzt kommt er auf die Intensivstation. Die Untersuchung der Fahrzeuge bringt Erstaunliches zu Tage: Hatte sich am Streifenwagen ein Marder zu schaffen gemacht, so wurden beim Motorrad die Bremsschläuche zerschnitten - ein Mordversuch! Hubert und Girwidz nehmen eine erste Spur im Fall des sabotierten Motorrads auf. Sie führt zu Fotografin Jessica Ganslmaier, mit der Fritz kurz zuvor ...

programme.title: In höchster Not - Bergretter im Einsatz
programme.desc: Lebensgefahr auf der Zugspitze - Lebensgefahr auf der Zugspitze Die Dokuserie bietet einen fesselnden Einblick in den Alltag von Bergretterinnen und Bergrettern der Bergwachten Ramsau und Grainau. In beeindruckenden Bildern werden echte, teils gefährliche Rettungseinsätze vor der atemberaubenden Kulisse der Bayerischen Alpen dokumentiert, stets aus der Perspektive der ehrenamtlichen Rettungskräfte. Bodycams und 360-Grad-Kameras machen die packenden Einsätze hautnah erlebbar. In dieser Folge erreicht die Bergwacht Grainau ein dramatischer Hilferuf vom höchsten Berg Deutschlands, der Zugspitze. Zwei Bergsteiger wurden in 2.900 Metern Höhe im Klettersteig von einem heftigen Gewitter mit Schneesturm überrascht und befinden ...

Wie leben die Menschen im Westen? Was bewegt sie? Und wie sieht ihr Alltag aus? Von montags bis freitags viertel nach vier erzählen wir Ihnen, was los ist in unserem Land, was die Menschen in NRW bewegt - was Sie bewegt.

programme.desc: Tamina in Athen - Athen gehört zu den günstigsten Städtereisen in Europa. Also genau das richtige Ziel für das Reise-Duo Tamina Kallert und Kameramann Uwe Irnsinger in einer Folge von "2 für 300". Mit 300 Euro in der Tasche inklusive Übernachtung geht's für ein Wochenende in die griechische Hauptstadt. Zwischen antiker und moderner Kultur entdecken Tamina und Uwe viele unerwartete Highlights. Im kontrastreichen Altstadt-Viertel Psiri fällt vor allem eins auf: bunte Street-Art wohin das Auge schaut. "Psiri ist so eine spannende Mischung aus Open-Air-Galerie und einem politischen Statement", findet Tamina. Überall präsent und ganz im Gegensatz dazu steht Athens antikes Gesicht. Doch der Besuch der Akropolis ...

programme.desc: WDR Talk-Klassiker - Welche Jugenderfahrungen verbinden Stefan Raab und den Kabarettisten Bruno Jonas? Warum ist Ralf Schmitz am Ende eines Gesprächs mit Sexualtherapeutin Ruth Westheimer sicher, dass er alles falsch gemacht hat? Und wieso mochte Udo Lindenberg die Hitparade nicht? Die ausgewählten Ausschnitte der Sendungen sind Sternstunden des Fernsehens im WDR. Intime Gespräche, unvergessliche Momente, Lachtränen, Rührung und Kopfschütteln inbegriffen - die besten Momente, die eine Talk-Show zu bieten hat, mit allen Facetten des intensiven, persönlichen Gesprächs: Amüsant und definitiv kurzweilig. programme.title: Jürgen B. Hausmann - "Wie jeht et? - Et jeht!"
programme.desc: " ""Kabarett direkt von vor der Haustür" ist schon seit vielen Jahren die Sache des Latein, Griechisch- und Geschichtslehrers Jürgen Beckers alias Jürgen B. Hausmann aus Alsdorf bei Aachen. Mit großem Erfolg begeistert er nicht nur die Ureinwohner westlich des Rheins, sondern schon länger auch in ferneren Regionen Deutschlands. In seinem Bühnenprogramm "Wie jeht et? - Et jeht!"" widmet er sich etlichen Redewendungen seiner Heimatregion, doch Jürgen Beckers Gedanken zu diesen Redewendungen, seine Alltagsbeobachtungen und seine Anmerkungen zum schier unvermeidlichen Fernsehkonsum sind eindeutig von überregionaler Lustigkeit. Heutzutage auf der Eckbank in der Küche und in der Sitzlandschaft ...

Viron Laulasmaalla sijaitsevassa Arvo Pärt -keskuksessa muistiinpanot ovat osa näyttelyä. programme.title: Notruf Hafenkante – Vorsicht Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Während einer Razzia stoßen Mattes und Melanie auf die hochschwangere Sandra Beyer, die sich einen gefälschten Ausweis besorgen wollte. Bald wird klar, Sandra ist seit Jahren auf der Flucht.Es stellt sich heraus, dass Sandra seit neun Jahren als Hauptverdächtige in einem Fall wegen Brandstiftung mit Todesfolge gesucht wird. Sie beteuert zwar ihre Unschuld, aber die Beweislage spricht gegen sie. Doch auch Franzi hat Zweifel an Sandras Täterschaft.Plötzlich setzen bei Sandra Wehen ein, und sie wird von Hans und Franzi ins EKH gebracht. Aufgrund von leichtem Fieber wird eine genauere Untersuchung durchgeführt. Bevor Jasmin Sandra jedoch mitteilen kann, dass ihr Baby durch eine Infektion in Lebensgefahr schwebt, ist diese aus dem EKH verschwunden. Um Sandra so schnell wie möglich zu finden und das Leben ihres Kindes zu retten, müssen die Polizisten sich mit Sandras Vergangenheit auseinandersetzen. Sie geraten in ein Geflecht von Lügen, Intrigen und enttäuschten Gefühlen. Niemcy. 2015. Serie

programme.title: SOKO Stuttgart – Mietfrei in den Tod
programme.desc: Die 76-jährige ehemalige Opernsängerin Olga Bechtle treibt tot im Pool ihres Hauses. Am Abend zuvor feierte sie eine Party, mit der sie sich auf eine lange Kreuzfahrt verabschieden wollte.Schnell ist klar, dass es sich um Fremdverschulden handelt. War der Täter einer der Partygäste? Die fast einjährige Weltreise wäre teuer geworden – woher hatte das Opfer so viel Geld, und wollte sich vielleicht jemand daran bereichern?Die Kommissare stoßen auf ein interessantes Finanzierungssystem: Olga Bechtle hatte ihr Haus nach einem Immobilienrenten-Modell zwar unter Marktwert verkauft, dafür aber mit lebenslangem Wohnrecht. Das SOKO-Team findet heraus, dass gleich mehrere Personen vom Tod Olga Bechtles profitieren.Im Fokus der Ermittlungen steht der Käufer des Hauses, Carsten Broicher, der. Niemcy. 2021. Serie

programme.title: Schuld & Sühne mit Paulina Krasa – Ein Vater verschwindet
programme.desc: Als ein Vater 2021 frühmorgens aus seinem Zuhause verschwindet, stößt seine Familie auf beunruhigende Hinweise. Paulina Krasa begibt sich auf Spurensuche.Polizeihauptkommissar Michael Bothe und sein Team stehen vor einem Rätsel. Die einzelnen Spuren ergeben zunächst wenig Sinn. Als das blutverschmierte Auto des Vermissten schließlich rund 80 Kilometer entfernt auftaucht, bestätigt sich ein schrecklicher Verdacht.Auch die Familie des Vermissten stößt auf beunruhigende Spuren. Ab sofort ermittelt die Mordkommission. Sie steht dabei vor einer schwierigen Aufgabe: Nicht nur der oder die Täter, auch das Opfer muss gefunden werden. Was es auch für die Ermittlungsarbeit und die Angehörigen bedeutet, davon berichtet Journalistin und Podcasterin Paulina Krasa in. Niemcy. 2025. Dokumentation

programme.title: Geld her! – Die großen Banküberfälle
programme.desc: Sie treibt die Gier nach dem großen Geld: Bankräuber! Sie träumen vom Coup ihres Lebens und werden zu Verbrechern. Mit List und oft auch Gewalt holen sie sich, was nicht ihnen gehört.Zurück bleiben oft traumatisierte Geiseln und manchmal sogar Tote. Lohnen tut sich das Verbrechen nur für die wenigsten. Nur jeder dritte Gangster kommt mit seiner Beute ungeschoren davon, sagt die Kriminalstatistik. Niemcy. 2026. Dokumentation
